items.title: Welcome to Listening Time
items.description:
The Robbinsdale Area School Board welcomes and encourages input and feedback from members of our school district community. The School Board Listening Time is held from 6:00 - 6:50 p.m. before the first board meeting of most months.

Facilitating this Listening Time will be Aviva Hillenbrand - School Board Treasurer, with DJ Brynteson - School Board Director and Dr. Kenneth Wutoh - School Board Director.

Questions? Send an email to Molly Olson, Executive Assistant to the School Board and Superintendent, at molly_olson@rdale.org
